generalAbilities.name: Electrocommunication
generalAbilities.description: Dust worm augurs communicate by shaping and reading electromagnetic fields. This functions like telepathy with creatures that share this ability.

generalAbilities.name: Electromagnetic Sight
generalAbilities.description: Dust worm aurgurs sense their surroundings by reading electromagnetic fields, including disruptions caused by creatures or objects. This is a precise sense within the listed range. Intense fields, such as areas emitting radiation or auras of electricity, make creatures within them Concealed to the diaspora worm.

defensiveAbilities.name: Electromagnetic Blindness
defensiveAbilities.description:
Dust worm aurgurs that take electricity damage must attempt a DC 43 Fortitude Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The worm is unaffected.

Success The worm is Dazzled for 1 round.

Failure The worm is Blinded for 1 round.

Critical Failure The worm is blinded for 1 round, then dazzled for 1 round.

offensiveAbilities.name: Electromagnetic Surge
offensiveAbilities.description:
The dust worm augur emits a concentrated wave of electromagnetism in a 50ft Type:cone. Each creature in the area must attempt a DC 40 Fortitude Saving Throw save. A creature with the tech trait uses the outcome one degree of success worse than the result of its roll.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and becomes immune to Electromagnetic Surge for 1 hour.

Success The creature's items with the tech trait become glitching 1 for 1 round.

Failure The creature becomes Stunned 1, and its items with the tech trait become glitching 2 for 1 minute. A creature with the tech trait also gains this glitching condition.

Critical Failure The creature becomes Paralyzed for 1 round, and its items with the tech trait become glitching 3 for 10 minutes. A creature with the tech trait also gains this glitching condition.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sandstorm Vortex
offensiveAbilities.description:
The dust worm augur conjures a hurricane of sand and metallic bits in a 15ft Type:emanation. This vortex moves with the worm and lasts for 1 minute. The vortex grants the worm resistance 11 to physical damage and makes any creature inside of it Hidden to creatures outside of it, and vice versa. Any creature that enters or starts its turn within the vortex must attempt a DC 40 Fortitude Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes 3d10 Slashing Damage damage.

Failure The creature takes 6d10 Slashing Damage damage and takes a –15-foot status penalty to all Speeds while within the vortex.

Critical Failure As failure, but 12d10 Slashing Damage damage, and the creature is also knocked Prone.

offensiveAbilities.name: Swallow Whole
offensiveAbilities.description:
Large, (6d12+10) Bludgeoning Damage, Rupture 38

See rules...

The monster attempts to swallow a creature of the listed size or smaller that it has grabbed or restrained in its jaws or mouth. If a swallowed creature is of the maximum size listed, the monster can't use Swallow Whole again. If the creature is smaller than the maximum, the monster can usually swallow more creatures; the GM determines the maximum. The monster attempts an athletics|defense:reflex check opposed by the grabbed creature's Reflex DC. If it succeeds, it swallows the creature. The monster's mouth or jaws no longer grab a creature it has swallowed, so the monster is free to use them to Strike or Grab once again. The monster can't attack creatures it has swallowed.

A swallowed creature is Grabbed, is Slowed 1, and has to hold its breath or start suffocating. The swallowed creature takes the listed amount of damage when first swallowed and at the end of each of its turns while it's swallowed. If the victim Escapes this ability's grabbed condition, it exits through the monster's mouth. This frees any other creature grabbed in the monster's mouth or jaws. A swallowed creature can attack the monster that has swallowed it, but only with unarmed attacks or with weapons of light Bulk or less. The swallowing creature is Off-Guard against the attack. If the monster takes piercing or slashing damage equaling or exceeding the listed Rupture value from a single attack or spell, the swallowed creature cuts itself free. A creature that gets free by either Escaping or cutting itself free can immediately breathe and exits the swallowing monster's space.

Effect: Engulf and Swallow Whole

If the monster dies, a swallowed creature can be freed by creatures adjacent to the corpse if they spend a combined total of 3 actions cutting the monster open with a weapon or unarmed attack that deals piercing or slashing damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Tongue Grab
offensiveAbilities.description: A creature hit by the dust worm augur's tongue becomes Grabbed. A creature can sever the tongue with a Strike against AC 42 that deals at least 38 Slashing Damage damage. This prevents the worm from using its tongue Strike until it regrows its tongue, which takes 1 day.

offensiveAbilities.name: Tongue Reel
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The dust worm aurgur has Grabbed a creature with its tongue

Effect The diaspora worm attempts to Reposition the grabbed creature toward the worm. If the grabbed creature is brought to within 10 feet or less of the worm, the worm can attempt to Swallow Whole the creature.
